subsystems.name: west_facade
subsystems.note: 3 portals + rose window, towers' lower mass

content.text: Plinth first — dark grey plate base.
Facade portals face +z — relaying the plinth to match that orientation.
Twin west towers with tall belfry arches.
Nave walls, 9 courses, with clerestory glass.
Flying buttress piers, fliers and pinnacles, both sides.
Dark stepped roof over the nave.
Taller towers, corner pinnacles, central balustrade.
Entrance steps on the parvis and a chevet of apse chapels at the east end.
Cheap ties: bridging plates across the plinth seams.
Tying the enclosed interior floors to the walls.
Those landed on the roof, not the floor — removing them.
Those were load-bearing — re-laying the ground layer under the nave.
Grounding each wall segment with plates tucked underneath.
